name: Komano Hina
source:
A first-year student, Yuna's underclassman and childhood friend. Always in a tracksuit.

A track and field team member whose popularity is on the rise thanks to her "wild" cuteness. Rarely talks, but can be surprisingly forthcoming when she has something to say.

Strong, sturdy, and fast. And loves food and meat. Don't get her started on tracksuits.

Strength: Easy to sleep, easy to rise, flexible
Weakness: All housework, fashion
Hobby: Exercise, running, collecting tracksuits
Skill: All exercise, eating a lot

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
